summary.t: Dreamcatchers with your baby's birth details

text.t:
A delicate and enchanting piece, created to eternalise the first details of your baby's life.
Made from pine plywood, with an oval shape and a name in gold or white acrylic, it brings together birth details in a unique and meaningful composition.
Delicate lace, silk ribbons, pom-pom trim, and natural wool thread bring a romantic and timeless decoration to life, finished with a gold acrylic heart featuring your baby's initial.
A little handmade treasure, where every detail tells a love story.

gpsr.warnings.0.t: Always hang out of reach of the baby — above or outside the cot, never inside it: the cord could entangle. Check occasionally that it remains securely fastened.
